description: Germany's Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) publishes freight transport statistics for goods carried by road, rail, water, air and pipeline (in-house works traffic excluded). The freight topic page links press releases, the GENESIS database tables, a dashboard, open data, methods and quality reports. Downloadable statistical reports include the monthly inland waterway freight statistics and maritime transport statistics, annual combined transport reports, and historical series such as rail operating data (discontinued after 2021) and the Fachserie 8 publications in the Statistical Library; with the Federal Office for Logistics and Mobility, Destatis also publishes the monthly truck toll mileage index for motorways. Coverage is national. The reports are free to download as XLSX and PDF files, and the tables can be queried and exported in the GENESIS-Online database. Caveats: some series have been discontinued or restructured, and the reports are in German. The freight volumes by mode support freight network flow, modal shift and capacity planning for German corridors, ports and waterways. They complement the BALM truck toll statistics and are related to the Destatis air transport performance data.
